note: Cups for the AIS haptic-search robot demo (ais_haptic/robot_frame.py). tcp_offset: UR set_tcp [m, rad], cup lip on the cup axis. chamber_map[i] = sensor channel of simulator chamber i; body_offset_deg = simulator body yaw minus tool yaw (seen from above). Both are measured with ais_chamber_check.py; until then calibrated=false and only --dry-run works. Old ROS1 hints (not trusted): 3ch pressure order [1, 2, 0]; yaw = -tool_yaw - 90 deg. lip_radius_mm: sealing-lip radius (simulator 5 mm); measure on the real cup.

ch3.chamber_check_note: Set by hand 2026-11-25 (user decision): nominal mounting, at the default pose (tool yaw -87 deg in the base frame) sensor 1 points 60 deg clockwise from base +x, sensor 2 60 deg counter-clockwise, sensor 3 along -x, i.e. 27 / 147 / -93 deg from the tool x-axis. The 2026-11-25 scan (cup leaking as a whole, differential analysis) gave 22 / 142 / -101 deg (body_offset -159.1), 6 deg from this.

ch5.note: tcp_offset is the value the 2026-11-26 fixture calibration was recorded with (run as ch6); the real cup length is absorbed by the object-top touch points.
